name: RTSTECH
recent: RTSTECH 于 2026 年 10 月发布截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日的年度经审计财务报表，并于 8 月公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日的半年度合并业绩。9 月另有一项「其他」类别公告，但资料未说明具体内容。
notable: 发布截至 2025 年 12 月 31 日财政年度的年度经审计财务报表。
公布截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日止期间的半年度合并业绩。

ann.title: Half yearly rpt on consolidated results for the financial period ended 30/06/2026

recent_en: RTSTECH released its annual audited accounts for the financial year ended 31 Dec 2025 in October 2026, after announcing its half-yearly consolidated results for the period ended 30 Jun 2026 in August. A separate 'OTHERS' announcement was made in September, but the materials do not specify its content.
notable_en: Released the annual audited accounts for the financial year ended 31 Dec 2025.
Announced half-yearly consolidated results for the period ended 30 Jun 2026.
